newsitem.title: USA: Microware, Taiwan Tatung in digital TV pact.
newsitem.headline: Microware, Taiwan Tatung in digital TV pact.

text.p: Microware Systems Corp said Tuesday it will join with Tatung Co Ltd to provide interactive digital television products aimed at private networks in apartment buildings, hotels, cruise ships, airlines and other areas of the hospitality market.
Microware and Tatung will initially provide the platform for system integrators to target audiences for in-flight movies and cruise lines with interactive digital set-top boxes, the company said.
Shares of Microware, a systems marketer, rose 3/4 to 15 on Nasdaq Tuesday.
